name: telegram-bot-kit
description: Portable Telegram bot kit with Cursor Agent integration.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @notame/telegram-agent && npm run build -w @notame/telegram-iiko-mentor
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @notame/telegram-agent && npm run typecheck -w @notame/telegram-iiko-mentor
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @notame/telegram-agent && npm run lint -w @notame/telegram-iiko-mentor
scripts.test: npm run test -w @notame/telegram-agent && npm run test -w @notame/telegram-iiko-mentor
